Maya (CS): FYI — CedarFrame onboarding: we're seeing tail latency and cost drift that could impact renewal if not addressed. want to propose a small perf playbook.
Jules (ML Eng): details?
Maya (CS): Quick summary: onboarding progress ~65%. P50 is fine (~90ms) but p95 spiked to ~420ms during peak yesterday. Token cost for their main route up ~18% month-over-month because of longer prompt history and heavy short-response traffic.
Owen (AE): Renewal check — they sign to annual 3mo from now, CFO is watching unit economics.
Ravi (SRE): Any errors? OOMs?
Maya (CS): No OOMs, error rate stable. It's throughput/latency + cost. Workload is lots of short chats (avg gen length 12 tokens) with repeated prefixes.
Jules (ML Eng): Sounds like a great fit for prefix caching + compact model fallback. Also int8 quantization could cut cost/latency materially. Did you run quality diff tests?
Maya (CS): Ran a small eval: 300 representative prompts. int8 (our compact-3b-int8) had mean acceptability drop ~1.8% and top-line NPS-like score stable; for non-sensitive routes accuracy delta negligible.
Owen (AE): If we can promise <2% quality regression and ~30% cost reduction, that's a renewal talking point.
Jules (ML Eng): Proposal: canary a model mix + routing change: 90% traffic to current model, 10% to compact-3b-int8 for parameterized debug mode; enable prefix/KV caching for repeated session starts; monitor eval set quality and p95.
Ravi (SRE): Operational checklist: add routing policy in Redwood Console, set canary window 72h, add autoscale buffer + rollback hook. I can add a circuit-breaker by latency threshold.
Maya (CS): Suggested action items: 1) @Jules run canary using eval harness + holdback metric set, 2) @Ravi deploy routing policy (10% -> compact-3b-int8) + caching config, 3) @Owen prep renewal messaging with projected savings and quality caveats, 4) Schedule enablement session with CedarFrame success team.
Jules (ML Eng): I'll spin the canary today. quick config I'll use: 
```json
{
  "routing": {
    "match": "route == \"chat_short\"",
    "strategy": "weighted",
    "weights": {"candidates/current": 90, "candidates/compact-3b-int8": 10}
  },
  "caching": {"prefix_cache": true, "kv_ttl_ms": 60000},
  "metrics": ["p95_latency", "cost_per_1k_tokens", "eval_accept_rate"]
}
```
Ravi (SRE): I'll wire that into the console. Deploy bot will post deploy events. set canary start now, auto-rollback if p95 > 600ms or accept_rate delta > 3%.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for cedarframe/chat_short (weights 90/10). Monitor logs at https://console.redwood.example/teams/cedarframe/deploys/1769876543
Maya (CS): Also capture customer sentiment — I'll add short survey inside their onboarding flow after a few interactions to quantify user-visible change.
Owen (AE): I'll loop in CFO contact and present the projected cost delta + contingency plan. Good call on canary.
Jules (ML Eng): Will run the eval harness and post results in this thread in ~24h. initial hypothesis: ~28-35% token cost reduction for chat_short, p95 drop ~120-150ms for canary traffic.
Ravi (SRE): Added routing policy, canary window 72h, alert thresholds set. I linked the dashboard: https://console.redwood.example/dashboards/cedarframe-routing-1769876543
Maya (CS): Thanks. Follow-ups: - @Jules paste eval summary, - @Ravi confirm rollback criteria fired if needed, - @Owen update renewal notes. I'll capture customer feedback after 48h. :chart_with_upwards_trend: 
Owen (AE): noted.
Jules (ML Eng): Eval results (prelim): 24h in, canary metrics on 10% traffic => cost_per_1k_tokens -32%, p95 for canary 140ms lower, accept_rate delta +0.6% (within tolerance). Posting full CSV to shared drive.
Maya (CS): excellent. I'll schedule a 30m enablement with CedarFrame operations this week and include the metric slides.
Ravi (SRE): If we keep this, recommend promoting compact-3b-int8 to 40% for non-sensitive traffic after 1 week of stable metrics, with autoscale buffer.
Maya (CS): Agreed. I'll update the playbook and update renewal risk to low if metrics stay stable. Thanks team :thumbsup:
